¿Para qué tipo de uso está pensado este portátil? 
Está pensado para tareas cotidianas como navegar por Internet, consultar el correo, trabajar con documentos, estudiar, realizar videollamadas y disfrutar de contenido multimedia. 
¿Es adecuado para tareas exigentes o gaming? 
Su configuración con Intel N100, 4 GB de RAM y 128 GB de almacenamiento está orientada a un uso básico. Para gaming exigente, edición de vídeo u otras tareas que requieran un alto nivel de rendimiento, se recomienda una configuración más potente. 
¿Qué incluye la caja? 
La caja incluye el portátil HP, el cargador y el folleto de configuración. 
¿Qué resolución tiene la pantalla? 
La pantalla de 15,6 pulgadas ofrece resolución Full HD de 1920 × 1080, adecuada para estudiar, trabajar con documentos, navegar por Internet y disfrutar de contenido multimedia. 
¿Qué sistema operativo y software incluye? 
El portátil incluye Windows 11 y 12 meses de Microsoft 365 Personal. La activación de Microsoft 365 requiere una cuenta Microsoft y está sujeta a los términos y condiciones del servicio.

title: Apple MacBook Air 13.6-inch with M5 Chip: Liquid Retina Display, 10-core CPU, 8-core GPU, 16GB Unified Memory, 512GB SSD, Wi-Fi 7, Spanish Keyboard; Midnight
features: READY TO TAKE OFF — The MacBook Air with M5 chip combines brutal speed and powerful AI performance in an ultraportable design. With Apple Intelligence,* up to 18 hours of battery life* and high-speed SSD storage from 512GB*, you can work, create and have fun wherever you go.

SUPERCHARGED WITH THE M5 — With a faster CPU and unified memory, the M5 chip multiplies the performance and fluidity of apps, so multitasking and creative projects run smoothly. Plus, the powerful Neural Engine and next-generation GPU with neural accelerators give you an incredible platform for AI.

APPLE INTELLIGENCE — Apple Intelligence is a personal intelligence system that helps you write, express yourself, and do your daily tasks effortlessly. It has revolutionary privacy features so no one else can access your data. Not even Apple. *
UP TO 18 HOURS OF BATTERY LIFE — MacBook Air delivers impressive battery life and performance so you can do everything in class or at work without having to worry about charging. *
A 13.6-INCH BRIGHT DISPLAY — The Liquid Retina display reproduces a billion colors. * Photos and movies show never-before-seen contrast and detail, and text looks super sharp.

12MP CENTER STAGE CAMERA — Be the centre of all video calls with Center Stage or show your workspace from above with Desk View. Plus, thanks to the three-microphone set and the four-speaker system with spatial audio and Dolby Atmos, everything sounds like cinema.

CONNECT WHAT YOU WANT — MacBook Air features two Thunderbolt 4 ports, a MagSafe charging port and a headphone jack, plus the Apple N1 chip for Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6 wireless connections. * And you can add up to two external monitors.

ON MACOS, APPS GO FLYING — Your favourite apps hit the accelerator on macOS, including the built-in FaceTime and Messages apps. Plus, virus protection and free software updates make sure your Mac runs smoothly and securely.

IF YOU LOVE THE IPHONE, YOU'LL LOVE THE MAC — The Mac works seamlessly with all your Apple devices. Copy what you want on the iPhone and paste it on the Mac, send text messages or answer FaceTime calls directly from the Mac. *

POWER ADAPTERS — Important: The 13-inch MacBook Air comes with a USB C to MagSafe 3 charging cable, but does not include a power adapter. A USB C power adapter or 30W or higher USB PD power supply is required to charge this device. Apple recommends using the Apple 30W USB C Power Adapter for optimal charging or the 70W USB C Power Adapter to take advantage of fast charging (up to 50% in 30 minutes).
